test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_convex_hull_carriers (r Ring, p Polygon, m MultiLineString) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_convex_hull_carriers WITH toFloat64(number % 1024) AS x, [(x, 0.), (x + 2, 0.), (x, 2.), (x, 0.)] AS ring SELECT ring, [ring], [[ring[1], ring[2]], [ring[3], ring[4]]] FROM numbers(100000)
test.query: SELECT groupConvexHull(r) FROM bench_convex_hull_carriers FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupConvexHull(p) FROM bench_convex_hull_carriers FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupConvexHull(m) FROM bench_convex_hull_carriers FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
